product_one_liner.value: Aviso AI provides an AI-powered revenue intelligence and execution platform for go-to-market teams to forecast revenue, manage the revenue lifecycle, and automate revenue actions.
product_one_liner.notes: Aviso describes an end-to-end revenue platform for GTM teams, covering the revenue lifecycle, forecasting, and autonomous actions: https://linkedin.com/company/aviso-inc.

pricing_page.notes: https://www.aviso.com/pricing is a public, navigation-linked pricing landing page describing flexible pricing, vendor buyout, onboarding, and migration terms. It requests a custom proposal and does not publish amounts or named tier breakdowns; this makes the distinction from a contact-only page somewhat ambiguous.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Aviso publishes customer case studies for New Relic and Honeywell: https://www.aviso.com/case-study/new-relic-chooses-aviso-ai-for-accurate-forecasting-of-its-consumption-based-revenue and https://www.aviso.com/case-study/why-did-honeywell-choose-aviso-for-ai-sales-guidance. | named_customers.0: A first-party case study identifies New Relic as choosing Aviso. | named_customers.1: A first-party case study documents Honeywell’s use of Aviso.

employee_band.notes: The company profile lists 201–500 employees: https://linkedin.com/company/3713385. This is a self-reported company-size band rather than an independently audited headcount.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Aviso explicitly identifies Redwood City, California as its headquarters: https://www.aviso.com/press/aviso-achieves-record-high-accuracy-rates-for-ai-powered-sales-predictions. | hq_country: Aviso identifies its headquarters as Redwood City, California in its press release; its company profile specifies US: https://www.aviso.com/press/aviso-achieves-record-high-accuracy-rates-for-ai-powered-sales-predictions and https://linkedin.com/company/3713385.

founded_year.notes: Aviso’s own press release explicitly says it was founded in 2012: https://www.aviso.com/press/aviso-achieves-record-high-accuracy-rates-for-ai-powered-sales-predictions. This is preferred over the conflicting 2014 date on LinkedIn.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed index at https://www.aviso.com/blog contains technical-sounding articles, but the examined architecture and ML posts are attributed to Bithika Bishesh. Her biography identifies her as Manager of Research & Content, not an engineer: https://www.aviso.com/blog/author/bithika-bishesh. The required pair of engineer-authored implementation posts was not established.

public_docs.notes: The public help center contains numerous linked documentation sections and articles covering accounts, deals, conversational intelligence, administration, and other modules: https://dochelp.aviso.com/en_US/welcome-to-aviso-ai/get-started-with-aviso-ai.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The complete open-role list at https://www.aviso.com/careers contains no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title; Data Engineer does not count. The separately found Senior Data Scientist listing explicitly says it is no longer accepting applications: https://jobs.scalevp.com/companies/aviso/jobs/74420347-senior-data-scientist.

model_provider.notes: Aviso explicitly says it has added GPT functionality to its platform. No particular GPT version is established by this statement: https://www.aviso.com/press/aviso-combines-generative-ai-with-its-conversational-deal-and-revenue-intelligence-capabilities-to-power-the-next-generation-of-b2b-content-creation.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: https://www.aviso.com/compliance-at-aviso-ai names all four standards. It describes ISO 27001 certification, a SOC 2 Type II audit, and a completed GDPR assessment. PCI DSS Service Provider Level 1 appears in its AWS-related compliance statement, rather than as an unambiguous standalone Aviso certification. | compliance_certs.0: Aviso describes a completed SOC 2 Type II audit of its platform. | compliance_certs.1: The compliance page explicitly says Aviso is ISO 27001 certified. | compliance_certs.2: Aviso claims a completed GDPR assessment and compliance review. | compliance_certs.3: PCI DSS Service Provider Level 1 is named in the AWS-related compliance statement; an independent Aviso certification is not established.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook labels the November 2020 financing Angel (individual), and the company announcement confirms funding from Silicon Valley angels and existing investors: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/57271-24 and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/aviso-launches-2020-state-of-virtual-selling-research-report-and-closes-additional-funding-301178993.html. | funding_date: The latest identified primary financing was announced November 23, 2020. PitchBook’s later June 2025 event is explicitly a secondary transaction, not identified as newly raised company capital: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/57271-24 and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/aviso-launches-2020-state-of-virtual-selling-research-report-and-closes-additional-funding-301178993.html. | funding_amount_usd: The November 2020 angel financing is listed without an amount in https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/57271-24, and its announcement does not disclose an amount: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/aviso-launches-2020-state-of-virtual-selling-research-report-and-closes-additional-funding-301178993.html. Older round amounts are not substituted.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified primary capital raise was November 2020, outside the 18-month window. The June 2025 event is classified as a secondary share transaction and is not counted as capital raised by the company: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/57271-24 and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/aviso-launches-2020-state-of-virtual-selling-research-report-and-closes-additional-funding-301178993.html.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive opening appears on the current careers index and has a dedicated open-role posting: https://www.aviso.com/careers/us/account-executive-1.

launched_6mo.notes: The June 16, 2026 announcement introduces AI CSM, an autonomous agent for managing digital customer-success accounts. That date falls within the six-month window: https://www.aviso.com/blog/introducing-aicsm-by-aviso.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Arun Sharma’s dated profile records a February 2026 start as Vice President of Creative at Aviso AI, within the 12-month window: https://linkedin.com/in/arun-sharma-scientistx.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: https://www.aviso.com/integrations explicitly lists Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and Siebel.
